$description: Semantic surface tokens — canonical nexus (dark obsidian) defaults; other themes override these roles only. Depth language: environment -> surface -> panel -> elevated -> overlay -> core (spec §8).

art.$description: Always-dark authored stage (game tables, oracle cloth, scene ground). Themes must not override — authored surfaces are theme-invariant, so text-on-art roles stay legible everywhere.

scrim.$description: Minimum backdrop for text legibility over glass surfaces (contrast guard, W2-146). Apply behind text on any backdrop-filter surface.
